component.name: Flint
component.summary: A fast command launcher and AI assistant for Linux

description.p: Flint is a native GTK command launcher for Linux. Search applications and files, switch windows, keep clipboard history and snippets, take notes, dictate text, and use local or user-configured AI providers.
AI credentials stay on the device. OAuth connections use the system browser, PKCE, and a loopback callback; local model providers require no cloud account.

ul.li: Instant search, recency ranking, and live file and weather results
Fix dictation aborting the app when recording starts
In-launcher previews for images, documents, folders, and media
Use a normal movable, resizable desktop window
Harden OAuth with PKCE, token refresh, and API-origin binding
Store AI credentials in the desktop keyring when available
